P01.rationale: A large portrait of a founder/worker anchors the right side of the page.

P05.rationale: The client name is present but lacks a distinct framed portrait element in this specific layout style.

P07.rationale: There are no press logos or review grids visible on the page.

P10.rationale: The large 'FAZIT' and 'Die Konsequenz' typography acts as a dominant decorative element.

P11.rationale: Real data visualizations are present in the form of specific metrics like '2.3-fache erhöht' and percentage figures.

P12.rationale: The layout is dense with text columns and graphical elements filling the sheet effectively.

P13.rationale: A darkened construction site background provides a strong atmospheric texture appropriate to the industry.

P14.rationale: The full-bleed photo is treated with heavy darkening so that overlaid text remains perfectly readable.

P16.rationale: A smartphone device mockup is shown in the worker's hand to add product credibility.

N07.rationale: The imagery depicts a specific construction site and worker rather than generic stock photography.

N08.rationale: There is minimal dead whitespace; the layout is tightly packed with content.

N10.rationale: Text sits on a darkened background without busy photo interference or awkward inset gaps.
